"""One-off R04 original-evidence reader; no App build or device execution."""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import runpy
import subprocess
import traceback
import urllib.request
import zipfile


ROOT = Path("D:/github/my/E-Track")
BASE = ROOT / ".cache/p3-8-implementation-20261021/.cache/p38/r04-20261023"
OWN = ROOT / ".cache/p38-r04-review-20261023"
IO = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / ".agents/skills/e-track-flutter-debug/scripts/host_io.py"))
CANDIDATE = "8ede09208a0857b716ee9614c09cb83247c2bc39"
DELIVERY = "6ec6c5ce3189de79794fc0cc437e9b024767ee5d"
PRIOR = "27048aa10079d8dd01d608967e7b5d1b473861ba"
APP = "app/bluetooth_flutter_Trace"
API = "https://api.github.com/repos/Eitan-S-23/E-Track/actions"
GROUPS = (
    ("red", 39823659366, "14e5d15714143f22a10de92930be1bf59578cd98", (635, 618), 1),
    ("red-behavior", 39824670865, "1ecabecad51dce141053fe054c87c7301eb03728", (746, 729), 6),
    ("repair-first", 39826146792, "596cc08be86ea4d540d938551140f892bbf43bf3", (748, 731), 5),
    ("green", 39827513211, CANDIDATE, (753, 736), 0),
)
OUT = {"schema": "p38-r04-original-review-v1", "formal_acceptance": "NOT_RUN",
       "checked_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
       "candidate": CANDIDATE, "delivery": DELIVERY, "new_builds": 0,
       "new_test_runs": 0, "device_operations": 0, "checks": [],
       "git_commands": [], "github": [], "development": [], "archives": []}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)
    OUT["checks"].append(message)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def fingerprint(path):
    path = path.resolve(strict=True)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return {"path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": digest.hexdigest()}


def git(*args):
    argv = ["git", "--no-optional-locks", "--no-pager", "-c", "core.quotepath=false", *args]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=40)
    require(result.returncode == 0, "git succeeded: " + " ".join(args))
    OUT["git_commands"].append({"argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                                "stdout_sha256": sha(result.stdout)})
    return result.stdout.decode("utf-8")


def api(suffix):
    url = API + suffix
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=25) as response:
        raw = response.read()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    OUT["github"].append({"url": url, "sha256": sha(raw), "body": data})
    return data


def env_for_gh():
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for name in ("GH_DEBUG", "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN",
                 "GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN", "GH_LOGFILE", "GH_FORCE_TTY"):
        env.pop(name, None)
    for name, folder in (("TEMP", "tmp"), ("TMP", "tmp"), ("GH_CACHE_DIR", "gh-cache")):
        path = IO["checked_output"](ROOT, OWN / folder)
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        env[name] = str(path)
    env["GH_PROMPT_DISABLED"] = "1"
    env["GH_HOST"] = "github.com"
    return env


def fetch_archive(meta, target, env):
    require(meta["size_in_bytes"] < 2_000_000, "bounded development archive size: " + meta["name"])
    path = IO["checked_output"](ROOT, target)
    if path.exists():
        require(fingerprint(path)["sha256"] == meta["digest"].split(":")[1],
                "existing owned archive still matches GitHub: " + path.name)
        return path
    auth = subprocess.run(["gh", "auth", "token", "--hostname", "github.com",
                           "--user", "Eitan-S-23"], cwd=ROOT, env=env,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=25)
    require(auth.returncode == 0 and bool(auth.stdout.strip()), "existing GitHub credential readable")
    child_env = dict(env, GH_TOKEN=auth.stdout.decode("utf-8").strip())
    endpoint = "repos/Eitan-S-23/E-Track/actions/artifacts/" + str(meta["id"]) + "/zip"
    result = subprocess.run(["gh", "api", "--hostname", "github.com", endpoint],
                            cwd=ROOT, env=child_env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=90)
    require(result.returncode == 0, "read-only artifact retrieval succeeded: " + meta["name"])
    require(sha(result.stdout) == meta["digest"].split(":")[1],
            "download matches immutable GitHub digest: " + meta["name"])
    require(len(result.stdout) == meta["size_in_bytes"], "archive exact size: " + meta["name"])
    IO["checked_output"](ROOT, path.parent).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with IO["checked_output"](ROOT, path).open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(result.stdout)
    return path


def bind_archive(path, meta, members, member_root):
    record = fingerprint(path)
    require("sha256:" + record["sha256"] == meta["digest"], "archive digest bound: " + meta["name"])
    record.update({"artifact_id": meta["id"], "name": meta["name"],
                   "published_digest": meta["digest"], "members": []})
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        require(archive.testzip() is None, "archive CRC: " + meta["name"])
        for file in members:
            member = file.relative_to(member_root).as_posix()
            matches = [n for n in archive.namelist() if n == member or n.endswith("/" + member)]
            require(len(matches) == 1, "unique original member: " + member)
            raw = archive.read(matches[0])
            actual = fingerprint(file)
            require(len(raw) == actual["bytes"] and sha(raw) == actual["sha256"],
                    "extracted original matches archive: " + member)
            record["members"].append(actual)
    OUT["archives"].append(record)


def audit_sources():
    identities = {}
    for revision in (PRIOR, CANDIDATE, DELIVERY, "main"):
        identities[revision] = {"commit": git("rev-parse", revision).strip(),
                                "tree": git("rev-parse", revision + "^{tree}").strip()}
    for revision in (CANDIDATE, DELIVERY):
        identities[revision]["app_tree"] = git("rev-parse", revision + ":" + APP).strip()
        identities[revision]["profile_blob"] = git("rev-parse", revision + ":Tools/provenance/manifest_profiles.json").strip()
    require(identities[CANDIDATE]["app_tree"] == identities[DELIVERY]["app_tree"], "handoff preserves exact App tree")
    for earlier in (GROUPS[0][2], GROUPS[1][2]):
        require(not git("diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--name-only", PRIOR, earlier,
                        "--", APP + "/lib", APP + "/android").strip(), "red run uses reviewed production: " + earlier)
    unchanged = [APP + "/android", APP + "/pubspec.yaml", APP + "/pubspec.lock", "Tools", ".github/workflows"]
    require(not git("diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--name-only", PRIOR, CANDIDATE,
                    "--", *unchanged).strip(), "Android/dependencies/runners/workflows unchanged")
    delta = git("diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", PRIOR, CANDIDATE, "--", APP)
    source = {}
    for name, spans in (("lib/services/ota_service.dart", ((174, 184), (1663, 1681), (1780, 1795), (2062, 2094))),
                        ("lib/pages/ota_upgrade_page.dart", ((58, 90), (121, 128), (164, 248))),
                        ("test/ota/ota_service_upgrade_test.dart", ((326, 462),))):
        text = git("show", CANDIDATE + ":" + APP + "/" + name)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        source[name] = {"blob": git("rev-parse", CANDIDATE + ":" + APP + "/" + name).strip(),
                        "sha256_utf8": sha(text.encode()),
                        "excerpts": [{"first_line": a, "text": "\n".join(lines[a-1:b])} for a, b in spans]}
    OUT["source"] = {"identities": identities, "app_delta": delta, "excerpts": source}


def audit_development(env):
    for group, run, commit, passed, failed in GROUPS:
        live = api("/runs/" + str(run))
        require(live["head_sha"] == commit and live["run_attempt"] == 1, "exact run/attempt: " + group)
        require(live["path"] == ".github/workflows/flutter-dev-checks.yml", "development workflow: " + group)
        require(live["conclusion"] == ("success" if failed == 0 else "failure"), "actual run disposition: " + group)
        artifacts = api("/runs/" + str(run) + "/artifacts?per_page=100")["artifacts"]
        for index, host in enumerate(("ubuntu", "windows")):
            platform = "ubuntu-latest" if host == "ubuntu" else "windows-2022"
            name = "flutter-dev-" + platform + "-" + str(run) + "-1"
            matches = [a for a in artifacts if a["name"] == name]
            require(len(matches) == 1, "unique development original: " + name)
            artifact_root = BASE / group / name
            paths = list(artifact_root.glob(".cache/flutter-dev-checks/runs/*/result.json"))
            require(len(paths) == 1, "unique result JSON: " + name)
            path = paths[0]
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            require(data["source_before"]["head"] == commit and data["source_before"]["clean"], "clean exact source: " + name)
            require(data["scope"] == "all" and data["formal_acceptance"] == "NOT_RUN", "full development-only scope: " + name)
            require(data["github_run_url"].endswith("/" + str(run)) and str(data["github_run_attempt"]) == "1", "result run binding: " + name)
            require(data["lockfile_unchanged"] and data["source_deltas_bound_toolchain_regen"], "recorded toolchain deltas: " + name)
            restored = data["source_after_restored"]
            require(not restored["dirty_semantic"] and not restored["dirty_untracked"], "restored semantic inputs: " + name)
            require(not restored["dirty_eol_only"] or restored["dirty_eol_only"] == [APP + "/windows/flutter/generated_plugin_registrant.h"], "only permitted generated EOL delta: " + name)
            item = {"group": group, "host": host, "report": fingerprint(path), "source_before": data["source_before"],
                    "source_after": data["source_after"], "source_after_restored": restored,
                    "toolchain_regen": data["toolchain_regen"], "development_result": data["development_result"], "commands": []}
            members = [path]
            for command in data["commands"]:
                log = path.parent / command["log"]
                members.append(log)
                record = {k: command.get(k) for k in ("name", "argv", "status", "exit_code", "timed_out", "diagnostics")}
                record["log"] = fingerprint(log)
                require(record["log"]["bytes"] == command["diagnostics"]["log_bytes"], "full raw log size: " + name + "/" + command["name"])
                text = log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
                lines = text.splitlines()
                if failed == 0:
                    require(command["status"] == "PASS" and command["exit_code"] == 0 and not command.get("timed_out"), "green command: " + name + "/" + command["name"])
                if command["name"] == "sdk_version":
                    item["sdk"] = command["diagnostics"]["sdk_identity"]
                    require(all(item["sdk"][k] in text for k in ("frameworkVersion", "frameworkRevision", "dartSdkVersion", "engineRevision")), "SDK raw identity: " + name)
                if command["name"] == "tests":
                    summaries = [line for line in lines if "All tests passed!" in line or "Some tests failed." in line]
                    require(bool(summaries), "raw test summary exists: " + name)
                    summary = summaries[-1]
                    counts = {key: int(m[1]) if (m := re.search(pattern, summary)) else 0
                              for key, pattern in (("passed", r"\+(\d+)"), ("skipped", r"~(\d+)"), ("failed", r"-(\d+)"))}
                    expected = {"passed": passed[index], "skipped": 16 if index == 0 else 33, "failed": failed}
                    require(counts == expected == command["diagnostics"]["test_counts"], "raw exact counts: " + name)
                    record.update({"raw_summary": summary, "counts": counts,
                                   "r04_lines": [{"line": i, "text": line} for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if "P38-R04" in line],
                                   "failure_details": [{"first_line": max(1, i-3), "text": "\n".join(lines[max(0, i-4):i+18])}
                                                       for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1) if "P38-R04" in line and "[E]" in line]})
                    if failed == 0:
                        names = {line[line.index("P38-R04"):] for line in lines if "P38-R04" in line}
                        require(len(names) == 7 and not any("[E]" in n or "[S]" in n for n in names), "seven executed R04 cases: " + name)
                        item["r04_cases"] = sorted(names)
                elif command["name"] == "analyze":
                    record["raw_tail"] = lines[-12:]
                item["commands"].append(record)
            OUT["development"].append(item)
            zip_path = fetch_archive(matches[0], OWN / "archives" / (group + "-" + host + ".zip"), env)
            bind_archive(zip_path, matches[0], members, artifact_root)
    jobs = api("/runs/39827513211/jobs?per_page=100")["jobs"]
    require(len(jobs) == 2 and all(j["conclusion"] == "success" for j in jobs), "both green jobs successful")


def audit_distribution():
    live = api("/runs/39829695971")
    require(live["head_sha"] == CANDIDATE and live["conclusion"] == "success" and live["run_attempt"] == 1, "standard build exact candidate")
    jobs = api("/runs/39829695971/jobs?per_page=100")["jobs"]
    for name in ("Build Android APK", "Build Windows EXE"):
        require(any(j["name"] == name and j["conclusion"] == "success" for j in jobs), "standard job success: " + name)
    for name in ("Deploy GitHub Pages", "Create GitHub Release"):
        require(any(j["name"] == name and j["conclusion"] == "skipped" for j in jobs), "no deployment/release: " + name)
    artifacts = api("/runs/39829695971/artifacts?per_page=100")["artifacts"]
    expected = {
        "standard/android/ble-monitor-android.apk": "1ef9cd86b35bd175b238a9c6ce542ce5fb991543fd0470684e82836e025b0f8d",
        "standard/windows/ble-monitor-windows.exe": "bb111ec40f24d74e971e6291d27e99d54f003993ad00c1cd2b1ad347a9b07be7",
        "standard/windows/ble-monitor-windows.zip": "cda4b776e33927fcddf9cb6c2d75c7ce654d3c0eed8366719eb6c06793f2b6ca",
        "standard-logs.zip": "3250ea7951e5a7fd91c454d3d2d3675bb3b046e3929c73489006fccb837b1050",
    }
    OUT["distribution"] = []
    for name, digest in expected.items():
        record = fingerprint(BASE / name)
        require(record["sha256"] == digest, "retained artifact hash: " + name)
        OUT["distribution"].append(record)
    for name, archive, folder in (("android-apk", "standard-apk.zip", "standard/android"),
                                  ("windows-exe", "standard-windows.zip", "standard/windows")):
        matches = [a for a in artifacts if a["name"] == name]
        require(len(matches) == 1, "unique standard archive: " + name)
        files = [BASE / p for p in expected if p.startswith(folder + "/")]
        bind_archive(BASE / archive, matches[0], files, BASE / folder)
    for name in ("standard/android/ble-monitor-android.apk", "standard/windows/ble-monitor-windows.zip"):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(BASE / name) as archive:
            require(archive.testzip() is None, "distribution CRC: " + name)
            if "windows" in name:
                require(sha(archive.read("ble_monitor.exe")) == expected["standard/windows/ble-monitor-windows.exe"], "embedded EXE equals standalone EXE")
    OUT["standard_logs"] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BASE / "standard-logs.zip") as archive:
        require(archive.testzip() is None, "standard log archive CRC")
        for name in archive.namelist():
            if not any(part in name for part in ("Run Flutter tests.txt", "Build release APK.txt", "Build Windows release.txt", "Analyze project.txt", "Checkout repository.txt")):
                continue
            raw = archive.read(name)
            lines = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
            warnings = [line for line in lines if "warning:" in line.lower()]
            record = {"member": name, "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": sha(raw), "warnings": warnings,
                      "decisive": [{"line": i, "text": line} for i, line in enumerate(lines, 1)
                                   if any(part in line for part in ("tests passed,", "No issues found", "Built build", "Already watching path", CANDIDATE, "P38-R04"))]}
            if "Run Flutter tests.txt" in name:
                expected_count = "753 tests passed, 16 skipped." if name.startswith("Build Android") else "736 tests passed, 33 skipped."
                require(any(expected_count in line for line in lines), "standard raw counts: " + name)
            if name.endswith("Build release APK.txt"):
                require(len(warnings) == 10 and any("Already watching path" in line for line in lines), "Android diagnostics retained")
            if name.endswith("Build Windows release.txt"):
                require(not warnings, "Windows build zero warning lines")
            OUT["standard_logs"].append(record)
    delivery = api("/runs/39845776205")
    jobs = api("/runs/39845776205/jobs?per_page=100")["jobs"]
    require(delivery["head_sha"] == DELIVERY and delivery["conclusion"] == "success", "handoff-only run successful")
    require(len(jobs) == 2 and all(j["conclusion"] == "success" for j in jobs), "both handoff jobs successful")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = IO["checked_output"](ROOT, args.out)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("audit output must be new")
    try:
        audit_sources()
        audit_development(env_for_gh())
        audit_distribution()
        OUT["result"] = "ORIGINALS_VERIFIED_NOT_FORMAL_ACCEPTANCE"
        status = 0
    except Exception as error:
        frame = traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)[-1]
        OUT["result"] = "ORIGINAL_AUDIT_ERROR"
        OUT["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error), "line": frame.lineno, "check": frame.line}
        status = 1
    OUT["evaluator"] = fingerprint(Path(__file__))
    OUT["evaluator"]["source"] = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    IO["write_json"](ROOT, output, OUT)
    print(json.dumps({"result": OUT["result"], "output": str(output), "checks": len(OUT["checks"]), "error": OUT.get("error")}))
    return status


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
